entries.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
entries.snippet: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

entries.title: 'Scourge' of abuse must be rooted out, says Pope, during Lourdes visit
entries.snippet: Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.

entries.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
entries.snippet: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

entries.title: Killer Christa Pike is to be executed within days but her defence say she's a victim too
entries.snippet: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

entries.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
entries.snippet: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

entries.title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
entries.snippet: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia are in the path of the powerful storm.

entries.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
entries.snippet: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

entries.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
entries.snippet: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".

entries.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
entries.snippet: Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for match against Israel.

entries.title: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
entries.snippet: Christy Spivey tells the BBC she only has more questions now police think Tasia Fortune's body was put in the tree after her death.

entries.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared
entries.snippet: Authorities said the heavy rains have subsided but the flooding is not yet over.

entries.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
entries.snippet: The independent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.

entries.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election
entries.snippet: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".

entries.title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
entries.snippet: CNN was scheduled to fly with US President Donald Trump for his trip to Tennessee on Saturday.

entries.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
entries.snippet: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

entries.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
entries.snippet: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.

entries.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
entries.snippet: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

entries.title: Inside the FBI hack: Agents fearful and angry after 'dangerous' data breach
entries.snippet: Current and former agents speak to the BBC about the devastating impact of the FBI hack.

entries.title: Young people in China are fangirling over a professor who gets their anxiety
entries.snippet: China's economy and tech have developed at breakneck speed, but there is plenty worrying its Gen Z.

entries.title: The treasured 'eternal snow' on this tropical island is about to disappear forever
entries.snippet: Climate change is transforming Papua's snowy peaks, which hold scientific value and spiritual significance.

entries.title: Playing 'La Bamba' for an hour? Must be a Mexican fandango!
entries.snippet: A 300-year-old Mexican musical tradition is finding new life around the world — one sweaty, joyous, all-night fandango at a time.

entries.title: Photos: These shepherds climb down a mountain to go to night school
entries.snippet: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

entries.title: From professor to patient: One man's journey on the frontier of lung cancer treatment
entries.snippet: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer, but new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients.

entries.title: Multiple arrests on suspicion of explosives offenses near U.K. base used by U.S. forces
entries.snippet: Police evacuated homes Sunday near an air base in England used by the U.S. and arrested several men over suspected explosives offenses.

entries.title: These Democrats are running for Congress on Christian faith. Will it pay off?
entries.snippet: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.

entries.title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
entries.snippet: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

entries.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
entries.snippet: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

entries.title: OpenAI says its models engaged with US government websites in misbehavior disclosure
entries.snippet: The disclosure is the latest in a string of incidents in which the AI platform has been caught going rogue. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.

entries.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

entries.title: Windy weddings and rocky cruises: How East Coasters are braving the nor'easter this weekend
entries.snippet: Northeast states saw rising tides and widespread power outages on Saturday as the storm ripped through the region. Forecasters expect significant winds and rain throughout the weekend.

entries.title: House Democrats plan vast oversight of Trump administration. Impeachment is an option
entries.snippet: "There is a cost to the American people of the out-of-control corruption," said Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries of New York, who is in line to become House speaker if Democrats win control at the Capitol.

entries.title: Hurricane Nolo expected to unleash powerful winds and flash flooding on Hawaii
entries.snippet: While direct landfall by the storm's center was not expected, forecasters said it could cause life-threatening flooding and mudslides, with parts of the Big Island expected to see rainfall totals up to 20 inches.

entries.title: Kennedy Center put off planned repairs despite known structural issues, former employees allege
entries.snippet: The center's executive director and chief operating officer, Matt Floca, did not treat the roofing issues as priorities and in April halted a funded plan to address them, according to the letter Thursday signed by David Seide, a lawyer representing the anonymous whistleblowers.

entries.title: German and Russian foreign ministers have rare meeting at United Nations General Assembly
entries.snippet: Lavrov was dismissive after the German and Russian foreign ministers met Saturday on the sidelines of the meeting, holding what's believed to be the first such tête-à-tête since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

entries.title: Bodies of 6 people, including 4 Americans, recovered from collapsed building in Athens
entries.snippet: The blast on Friday was believed to have been caused by a major gas leak, Athens Mayor Haris Doukas said. Neighboring buildings were damaged and evacuated.

entries.title: China and U.S. agree to establish AI safety channel and continue trade and military talks
entries.snippet: The summit produced no major breakthroughs, but analysts said the steps toward greater cooperation were important because they established working groups that could help prevent disputes from escalating.

entries.title: Trump administration uses rare authority to claw back nearly $1B in spending approved by Congress
entries.snippet: Most of the cuts are focused on Health and Human Services programs that serve refugees and unaccompanied minors accused of being in the country illegally.

entries.title: Pope Leo draws 800,000 people to central Paris for open-air Mass on iconic square
entries.snippet: The turnout testified to the church's lasting influence in France despite declining attendance and secularizing trends that have emptied churches across Europe.

entries.title: CNN says it was left off Air Force One for Trump's Saturday trip to a college football game
entries.snippet: CNN, a member of the U.S. network video pool that rotates duties shooting and sharing video coverage of the president, reported it had been scheduled to fly aboard the president's plane Saturday for a scheduled visit to a college football game.

entries.title: Trump rejects Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and other Middle East news
entries.snippet: Iran offered this week to reopen the strait and resume talks on its nuclear program in seven days if the U.S. lifts its naval blockade of Iranian ports, waives sanctions on Iranian oil sales and observes a ceasefire that would include Lebanon.

entries.title: Powerful nor'easter causes coastal flooding and knocks out power to parts of the northeast U.S.
entries.snippet: Tens of millions of people were in the path of the nor'easter, which was forecast to affect the Mid-Atlantic area and New England throughout the weekend.

entries.title: Hacks by autonomous AI agents raise thorny questions of legal accountability
entries.snippet: What happens when the hackers aren't human? That's the question at the center of a public policy debate following disclosures by leading tech companies that their AI models went rogue and hacked into other organizations.

entries.title: What the Supreme Court's voter-citizenship database decision means for the midterms

entries.title: Health care costs a major concern for voters ahead of midterms

entries.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump-backed Missouri congressional map for third time
entries.snippet: The justices halted a federal appeals court ruling that would have revived the Republican-friendly map for the November elections, which will determine control of Congress. There were no noted dissents.

entries.title: Wrongfully detained Iranian American journalist remains jailed in Iran after 2 years
entries.snippet: This week marks two years that Iranian American journalist Reza Valizadeh has been detained in Iran. For a decade, he worked for Radio Farda — an independent, but U.S.-funded Farsi-language news service. During a trip to Iran to visit family, Valizadeh was arrested and sentenced

entries.title: Violence has displaced more than half a million Mexican households in past 5 years
entries.snippet: Until now, Mexico's government did not share comprehensive data on people who have been forced to flee their homes due to ongoing violence in many parts of Mexico, leaving civil society groups piecing together information to get a wider view of the problem.

entries.title: GOP's big bet on Texas Latino voters could backfire in midterms
entries.snippet: Texas Republicans redrew the state's congressional map last year, making a bet that Latino voters who broke for President Trump in 2024 could be the foundation for victory in 2026. But as Liz Landers reports, immigration crackdowns and rising everyday costs in South Texas may be

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Pope decries 'scourge' of sexual abuse during France visit
entries.snippet: French bishops took "courageous" steps when faced with "the painful scourge of abuse of minors," Pope Leo XIV told the high-ranking clerics before his scheduled meeting with survivors at the Catholic shrine of Lourdes.

entries.title: Germany news: Are Germans giving up their beloved meat and sausages?
entries.snippet: Germans used to be all about sausages and meat. While those do remain popular, things seem to be slowly changing. There also are new insights into the economic side of East Germany's espionage DW has more.

entries.title: UK reports 'major incident,' arrests near Fairford air base
entries.snippet: Multiple buildings were evacuated in the UK town of Whelford, near an air base used by the US military, with UK police saying bomb disposal teams were checking vehicles on the scene. Several men had been arrested.

entries.title: Northern Ireland: Pro-UK march to go through Catholic area
entries.snippet: Northern Ireland: Pro-UK march to go through Catholic area

entries.title: India news: Assam Police detain CJP's Ashutosh Ranka
entries.snippet: Ranka has criticized Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma over schools, land rights and electoral boundaries. DW has more.

entries.title: Iran sticks to Hormuz plan after Trump rejects it
entries.snippet: Iranian officials that while they were aware of Trump's comments on rejecting the new proposal, they had not received a formal message rejecting the plan that would open the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.title: No public mentions of Taiwan at official Xi and Trump meeting
entries.snippet: At a high-profile summit between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in Washington, there was much talk of trade and artificial intelligence. One of the most contentious issues, Taiwan, was only discussed in private.

entries.title: China sends two giant pandas off to Atlanta zoo after Xi-Trump summit
entries.snippet: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang took off to Atlanta on a FedEx plane, with steamed corn buns, carrots and bamboo to snack on during the flight. Their trip is one of the few concrete things to come out the Xi-Trump summit.

entries.title: Gunmen kill 27 people in two mass shootings in South Africa
entries.snippet: South African police have launched a search for suspects after 17 people were found dead at a tavern southwest of Johannesburg. A separate tavern shooting near Cape Town left 10 dead.

entries.title: Why farmers are pairing crops with solar panels
entries.snippet: From cooler soil to paid grazing land, farmers in the US are finding that solar panels can do more than generate power.

entries.title: Powerful storm batters northeast US, hundreds of flights canceled
entries.snippet: Hundreds of flights were canceled and thousands were delayed as a nor'easter brought flooding, power cuts and travel disruption to cities like New York, Boston and Philadelphia.

entries.title: Spain: Thousands protest in Madrid against housing crisis
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands rallied in the Spanish capital after an 87-year-old woman was dramatically evicted from her home this week. Protesters called for measures to curb rising costs and reduce evictions.

entries.title: Backlash over data centers tests Europe's AI ambitions
entries.snippet: Massive data centers needed to run AI are triggering protests across Europe. Their operators counter that they boost digital sovereignty and energy independence.

entries.title: China, US agree to set up channel for AI safety incidents
entries.snippet: Following the summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, the two superpowers pledged to set up a "communication channel" for AI incidents and boost coordination on military matters.

entries.title: Trump rejects Iran proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump says he has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and put an end to hostilities. "I'd like to make a deal, too," he said. "But that deal would not be acceptable."

entries.title: Paris: Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass before huge crowd
entries.snippet: The pope addressed around 700,000 people during a Mass at the Place de la Concorde, near the Champs-Elysees. Leo XIV is on a four-day visit to France.

entries.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe
entries.snippet: Drone explosions, airspace violations, arson attacks: Poland, Romania, and Moldova are now regularly targeted in Russian attacks against Ukraine. More governments are calling these attacks deliberate acts of aggression.

entries.title: Germany's FM Wadephul meets Lavrov on UNGA sidelines
entries.snippet: It's the first such meeting since Russia launched the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. DW has the latest on day 5 of the UN General Assembly debate.

entries.title: Pakistan: Suicide attack at police stop kills at least 11
entries.snippet: The blast was claimed by the Pakistani Taliban, which has stepped up attacks on Pakistani security forces in recent years.
